landing.final_lead: Up and running in 2h. Support 7 days a week in French, English and Arabic.
landing.overview_lead: No bloated suite — just what it takes to run a gym day to day.
landing.overview_1_desc: Group classes, EMS slots, automatic waitlist — your coaches see it all at a glance.
landing.overview_2_desc: Full profiles, automatic reminders, renewals in one click.
landing.overview_3_desc: Cash, card, transfer — one single ledger, zero spreadsheets.
landing.overview_4_desc: Profiles, roles, mobile app access — the whole team in one place.
landing.footer_made: Built for gyms and fitness studios.
landing.features_lead: Not big-gym software shrunk to fit: one-to-one sessions, cabins, passes, and members you know by their first name.
landing.f_planning_d: One-to-one, small-group and classes on one schedule. Never two sessions in one cabin, never a coach in two places — the system guarantees it.
landing.f_memberships_d: “10 sessions valid 8 weeks”, monthly, unlimited. The balance counts down with each booking, and a membership can be paused for an injury or a holiday.
landing.f_member_d: Contraindications the coach can see, signed declaration, sessions left, attendance and payments on one screen.
landing.flow_title: Like a session, one thing into the next
landing.flow_lead: Three moments of a typical day — each feeds the next, no double entry.
landing.flow_1_d: You book their trial and note their contraindications. Their coach sees them before starting.
landing.flow_2_d: They then book their own slots, get a reminder the day before, and their balance counts itself down.
landing.flow_3_d: Payment, receipt, renewal. Revenue, attendance and passes running out update live.
landing.footer_tag: Management software for EMS, Pilates, yoga and personal-training studios.
landing.stats_benefit_3: Support 7 days a week in French, English and Arabic
landing.integrations_lead: Payment and access control — already built to plug into your gym.
landing.problems_title: What looks simple to your member costs the gym's admin dearly.
landing.problems_lead: On the member's side, everything feels smooth. On the gym's side, the reality is often very different.
landing.problems_item_1: Subscriptions that lapse without anyone noticing in time
landing.problems_item_2: Late payments that never get followed up
landing.problems_item_3: Hours lost every week on a notebook or a spreadsheet
landing.problems_item_4: No visibility into who's actually in the gym today
landing.problems_item_5: A poorly managed schedule where your coaches clash
landing.problems_item_6: No reliable data on which plans actually work
landing.solutions_title: Built for your type of gym.
landing.solutions_lead: A tailored setup and journey for your business.
landing.testimonials_title: Gyms running their business with Fitora.
landing.testimonials_quote_1: We dropped the notebook and the spreadsheet in the first month. Everything finally lives in one place.
landing.testimonials_quote_2: Automatic payment reminders saved us an incredible amount of time.
landing.testimonials_quote_3: Our coaches manage their schedule from their phone, without calling us.
landing.testimonials_note: * Fictional names — replace with your real customers before publishing.
landing.mobile_feat_1_d: Today's schedule, always up to date.
landing.mobile_feat_2_d: A cancelled session, a late member.
landing.mobile_feat_3_d: Mark attendance without leaving the mat.
landing.roi_title: How much are late payments and lost renewals really costing you?
landing.roi_lead: An estimate, based on your own numbers.
landing.roi_label_churn: Share of avoidable non-renewals with reminders (%)
landing.roi_foot: Estimate based on your numbers and an assumed 60% recovery of late payments and non-renewals through automated reminders. To refine with an advisor.
landing.faq_q_1: Does Fitora take a commission on my payments?
landing.faq_a_1: No. Your Fitora subscription is a fixed fee, with no commission on payments collected from your members.
landing.faq_q_2: Is Fitora compatible with my current tools?
landing.faq_a_2: Fitora integrates with the most common payment gateways, SMS providers and access control systems in Tunisia and the region.
landing.faq_q_3: Does Fitora replace my notebook and spreadsheet?
landing.faq_a_3: Yes, that is exactly its job: members, passes, payments and the schedule in one place.
landing.faq_q_4: How long until I'm up and running?
landing.faq_a_4: Count on 2 hours to set up your plans and schedule. On Pro, import your members from a CSV file.
landing.faq_q_5: Is my gym a good fit for Fitora?
landing.faq_a_5: Fitora adapts to classic gyms, CrossFit boxes, yoga/pilates studios and 24/7 gyms.
landing.faq_a_6: The main local and international payment methods, depending on the gateways enabled for your gym.
landing.faq_q_7: Do I get support along the way?
landing.faq_a_7: Yes, an advisor stays available 7 days a week in French, English and Arabic after go-live.
landing.faq_a_8: No fixed-term commitment — you can stop at any time.
landing.faq_q_9: Can my coaches use Fitora on mobile?
landing.faq_a_9: Yes, every coach sees their day's sessions, their members and their contraindications from their phone.
landing.number_no_clash: double bookings possible — the constraint lives in the database, not in the screen.
landing.number_languages: languages on every screen and every receipt — French, English, Arabic.
landing.number_trial: free trial of the core features, no card needed.
landing.pricing_lead: No card needed. After that, you ask for activation from your account — every feature is included.
landing.pricing_small: of full access, no credit card
landing.pricing_after: After that, a monthly subscription based on the modules you keep.
landing.f_slots_d: Open the week's EMS or coaching slots once and for all; members take their appointment from their app. A taken slot disappears for everyone else.
landing.f_trial_d: A prospect's trial is booked in two clicks, without selling them a membership. A single session stays owed until it is collected.
landing.f_reminders_d: Every member is reminded before their session, on their app. Fewer no-shows, fewer lost slots.
landing.number_languages_short: languages on every screen and receipt
